testResults.name: focused-data-contract-tests
testResults.command: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_lake_data_contracts.py

decisions: The path contract is date=YYYY-MM-DD/asset_class=<asset>/data_type=<type>/<symbol>.parquet for all six supported asset and data type pairs.
Symbols are trimmed, uppercased, validated, and percent-encoded as one filename component; BTC/USD is BTC%2FUSD.parquet while compact OSI symbols remain readable.
All event timestamps are UTC nanoseconds, prices and fractional crypto quantities are decimal128(38, 18), and provider integer sizes and IDs retain unsigned or signed integer types as applicable.

Each immutable registry entry carries lake.schema and lake.schema.version metadata; nullability is limited to provider-optional equity updates and crypto identifiers, venue codes, or taker sides that vary by feed.
limitations: CLEO export and RCASD records specify the six datasets and storage invariants but contain no attached field-by-field schema document; schema version 1 therefore makes the Alpaca SIP, OPRA, and crypto payload contract explicit in code and exhaustive tests.
Parquet writing and object replacement are intentionally deferred to T022.
